reason: I make about $20k a year, so $147 a month is real money for something with zero published results. And it sends from my Instagram, which is my storefront. I'm not putting it on autopilot for a tool nobody has proven yet.
objection: If Instagram restricts my main account, a refund of that month doesn't bring back my content, followers or clients. Also, it only sends while Chrome is open, so I'd have an Instagram tab running for hours anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from a few founding members who are in my situation (small, under $5k a month), and a price closer to $50-ish, or a way to test it on a throwaway second account with no risk to my main one.
